entry.query_or_scope: the full name of the person this order concerns (given name, any middle names or initials, surname; also 'Surname, Given'), case-insensitive, in every other held order text; 59 census orders have no held text and were not searched; 296 of 2231 one-person orders had no parsable name and were not searched (SEARCH_COVERAGE.csv); a match is a name match, not an identity authentication
entry.repository: held order texts in this repository (30725 text files for 14913 of 14972 census orders, produced by app-executive-orders, csc-annual-reports, fr-originals, hathi-gpo-orders, indian-reservations-1912, isthmian-canal-1911, numbered-early-orders, ofr-compilations, pinakes-proquest-ingest, richardson-volumes, wikisource-texts)

notice: Leads only. A name match is not an identity authentication, a date, an ending or a status.
